journey.name: Search transaction
journey.description: Looks up a transaction by id on the Transactions screen and verifies the app handles the query without crashing. The genesis coinbase is never in a loaded wallet, so the lookup must fail with one of exactly two messages, depending on the sync state.

actions.action: Launch the Mandacaru app and wait for the splash screen to dismiss (poll until nav_node is present)
Verify the transaction id field (input_txid) is displayed
Type "4a5e1e4baab89f3a32518a88c31bc87f618f76673e2cc77ab2127b7afdeda33b" into the transaction id field (input_txid)

Verify the message matches the sync state — it is a short-lived snackbar, so poll the layout right after typing instead of waiting a few seconds (read initialblockdownload with the README's RPC recipe): while syncing it starts "Node is still syncing (" and ends "Transaction may appear once the relevant block is processed."; once synced it is exactly "Transaction not found". Any other text (e.g. "Failed to fetch transaction" or "Transaction not found: …") is a FAIL — it means the node's error format changed
Clear the field and type a 63-character hex string; verify "Invalid transaction ID format" is shown without an RPC call

Optional, only on a synced node with a loaded wallet: type a txid from that wallet's history (Electrum blockchain.scripthash.get_history) and verify a result card with txid, confirmations, inputs and outputs is shown and logcat has no "getrawtransaction parse error"
